segments.text: So, in Nithratantra, as it is explained like this, Dharana, Dhan and Samadhi also direct you towards the state of consciousness of Lord Shiva.
So, this kind of Dharana will carry you, and that kind of Dharana will mislead you.
So, then show it is completely matter.
It is mental, yes.
It is internal, yes.
Next Sutra, Mohayat, Anantabogat, Sahaji Vidyajaya.
When this after, when you conquer or after conquering or surpassing the field of illusion of Maya,
which does not get subsided until the last feet, impressions also are removed, destroyed.
Anantabogat means various, many impressions also must be removed, also must be destroyed.
Till then this moha is there, moha will never go.
If you conquer it also, it will never go.
You will surpass it only when the last feet, impressions are also removed or destroyed.
Then, one gets victory of pure knowledge of consciousness.
Sahaji Vidyajaya, Jaya means victory, victory of pure knowledge of consciousness.
Mohayat says, Akayatatma, Samanantapashatma, maya, maya, maya, jaya.
When moha, moha illusion, illusion is the all differentiated universe,
the impressions and experiences of all this differentiated universe is illusion, is filled with illusion.
When this illusion is Jaya, conquered, conquered means Abibavat, subsided.
Abibavat means when you subsided.
Then and this victory will come only, Ananta, samskara, prashma, parienta, abog, vistaro, yes, here.
Samskara, prashma, parienta, samskara, prashma, parindra, when the last feet, impression, impressions of all this illusion are also destroyed.
Not till then, then you conquer the moha illusion and then comes with your knowledge, pure knowledge.
That is Vedana, Nadyadharma, when eternal aspects are revealed and Supreme God consciousness is also obtained and so on.
This is half Shloka there.
Then this kind of Supreme, pure knowledge of consciousness is held and you get victory on it.
You attain it, you achieve it.
So Anopayasya, pishakto, paya, pariyasana, it took that thought.
Hence, the conclusion is here in Anopaya also, one can be capable of entering in Shambhupaya.
After entering in Shaktopaya, when Anopaya is complete and you get entry in Shaktopaya and that when Shaktopaya is complete, you get entry in Shambhupaya.
So by Anopaya also, you can be led, you can be headed to the state of Shambhupaya.
Tathacharya Sri Sathchandha, it is also said in Sathchandtantra, Samanantamvararohe, Pashijalam, Rantakam.
But to Samanana, Samanana, when mind is destroyed and the impressions are there, the impressions of mind are there,
but the mind is absolutely destroyed with the exception of impressions, with the exception of its impressions, mind is totally destroyed.
Impressions do remain. This state is called Samanana. Impressions are there, but mind is gone.
After that point, coverings are living. You have put that suite in first or second story.
Samanantamvararohe, Pashijalam, Anantakam. So this class of Pasha, the class of bondages is unlimited up to Samanana, up to the state of Samanana.
Samanana is that state, where the mind is totally destroyed with the exception of its impressions.
Impressions are there. When one is born to ashes. Impressions of that basma is there. There is some impression there.
Pasha, Lokanam, Tehta, Surupa, Lokanam, Hiyat, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya.
Vidya, Jaya, one gets victory of pure knowledge, of consciousness, sahaja Vidya.
When you conquer or surpass the field of illusion, mohjayat, Anantavogat, until the last faith impressions also are vanished.
Then you get victory of pure knowledge of consciousness.
Samanantamvararoha Pasha, Jaya, Anantakam.
O Devi, this bondage, this collection of bondages is unlimited, until you cross Samanana, the state of Samanana.
Now he quotes Sachhantantra.
Surupa, Lokanam, Hiyat, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya, Atvya.
At the time of pure knowledge you get experience in two ways, one experiences, you get experience
in two ways. One is called aathimyavati, pervasion of God consciousness. When you purveid and
reside in God consciousness, that is aathimyavati. And when you purveid in universal God consciousness,
that is Shivyavati. Actually, if God consciousness also takes place, that God consciousness is also
bondage. In one way, you have to leave that. You have to surpass that God consciousness. God
consciousness only won't do. What take care of you to that supreme limit of highest limit
of reality. Now, he explains how God consciousness takes place. Pasha, lokanam, takta, you have to put aside
experiencing all these Pasha's bondages. Bondages is just different set of knowledge. Then you experience
each and every object of world separated from God consciousness. That is Pasha. That is bondage.
You have to experience in each and every action of life, God consciousness. When you discriminate
that separately, that God consciousness is pure and this consciousness in worldly life is impure.
That is Pasha. When you abandon that and put yourself sentence your mind towards God consciousness,
pure God consciousness. That is Swaroop alokanam. When you experience only yourself,
atvavati or bhavati asya, this is known as Parvati of God consciousness. Parvati of Atma.
Shivyavati is Tato niyata. But Shivyavati is separate and supreme than this God consciousness.
Now, he explains, what is Shivyavati? Sarvagyayati guna yertha vyaapakan bhavayati yadav. When
agent every object of universe is found, is experienced as completely filled with all knowledge and all action and all will.
When you find agent every object of your life filled with knowledge, action and will. Just like Lord Shiva does.
This is Shivyavati. This is Parvati of Shiva. Chaitanya heh turupini. This only is the way to direct you towards the
kingdom of Chaitanya, the state of the state of ultimate freedom.
Parvati of God consciousness is also illusion. That you have to surpass. That you have to throw away, put aside.
Unmana, Shivyavati, Atma, Sahaja Vidya, Pravati, Rukta, then you will be capable of achieving the pure
knowledge of Unmana. That is Parvati on universal God consciousness. Shivyavati. It is already said in
Sushanda. After that, when you are experiencing the abundance, throwing aside, keeping aside this
bondage of Pasha, and putting your consciousness in your own self. That is God consciousness.
After that, you have to throw that also aside. Atma-tata-tata-tata, then you have to get rid of Atma-tata.
God consciousness is also to be abandoned. Then Vidya-tata-tata-tata-tata-tata-tata, then you have to connect
your consciousness in Vidya, in pure knowledge of consciousness, and there you will find Unmana, the state of
Unmana, where Manay is not existing at all, because Manay is Sankalpa. Manay is only differentiated
knowledge. The collection of differentiated knowledge is man. It may be pure, it may be
impure. That doesn't matter. Pure knowledge, impure knowledge all are in the bondage
of in the circle of mind, limitation. So, Sankalpath Kramato, when you cross beyond the Sankal,
good and bad, beyond the Sankal pure and impure. There is no difference between individual consciousness
and God consciousness. In fact, when you go to the depth of understanding, then God consciousness
is as good as individual consciousness. That is in which we are living. Our life is filled with
individual consciousness. Yogis life is filled with God consciousness and Parma Yogis life is
filled with universal God consciousness. Universal God consciousness is the state of unmana.
Individual God consciousness is the state of manna and God consciousness is the state of self.
And that self-two is to be abundant. So, this is the supreme knowledge, where you find the
universal God consciousness. Shiva you have to. Parvajan on Shiva. There is no other better knowledge than this
because it is Vidya. Now he defines what Vidya actually is. There is Vedana, Bodhana and Varsana.
These three aspects are found in Vidya. Vedana, Bodhana and Varsana. Vedana, knowing, Bodhana,
infusing your consciousness and Varsana, discarding away some foreign material from yourself.
Vedana, you have to know what is the eternal aspect of Lord Shiva. Anadidarmasya means eternal
aspect of Lord Shiva. Eternal aspect of Lord Shiva is all knowledge, all will and all action. All
knowledge, all will and all action. Universal knowledge, universal will and universal action is Anadidarm. Anadidarm
is an eternal aspect. Those aspects which are which never get faded, which never get lessened,
which are never lessened. When you know that Vedana, Anadidarmasya, where knowledge of that eternal
aspect is held, Paramatma, Bodhana, where knowledge of Supreme God consciousness is also achieved,
Varsana, Aparamatma, where negation of that universal God consciousness is discarded away. Negation of
universal God consciousness is negated, put aside, where universal God consciousness is held. That
in reality is called Vidya knowledge. Tatrasthva, Venjaya, Teja, Param, Paramakaranam, there you should get
yourself established. Tatrasthva, at that state, one must get established and then Supreme
light of God consciousness, Supreme light of universal God consciousness will appear. Venjaya,
which is the only cause of entering in your real nature, Paramakaranam.
